eventScripts.script:
if currentValue.value:
		import traceback
		startTime = system.date.now()
		try:
			# read in required values
			readPaths = [
				 "[.]../Parameters.MinutesBack"
				,"[.]../Parameters.GroupByMS"
				,"[.]../Tags/Tags"
			]
			
			tags = system.tag.readBlocking(readPaths)
			
			minutesBack = tags[0].value
			groupByMS = tags[1].value
			tagsDataset = tags[2].value
			
			# setup time range
			alarmStartDate = system.date.addMinutes(startTime, -minutesBack)
			
			# pull alarm history
			myPaths = list(tagsDataset.getColumnAsList(tagsDataset.getColumnIndex('alarmSourceWildcard')))
			results = system.alarm.queryJournal(
				journalName="DataCenterDemoJournal", 
				path = myPaths,
				startDate=alarmStartDate, 
				endDate=startTime, 
				state=['ActiveUnacked'], 
				all_properties=[("IsSystemEvent","=",'False')]
				)
				
			# make lookup dictionary
			alarmSourceDict = {
				tagsDataset.getValueAt(i, 'alarmSourceStart') : i
				for i in xrange(tagsDataset.getRowCount())
			}
			
			# create dictionary to group results by second
			alarmDict = {}
			for r in results:
				alarmStart = str(r.getSource()).split(':/alm:')[0]
				myIndex = alarmSourceDict[alarmStart]
				aisle = tagsDataset.getValueAt(myIndex,'aisle')
				sensor = tagsDataset.getValueAt(myIndex,'sensor')
				name = tagsDataset.getValueAt(myIndex,'name')
				
				alarm = r.getName()
				roundedTime = r['EventTime'].getTime() / groupByMS * groupByMS
				sensorInfo = {'eventValue' : r['eventValue'], 'index' : myIndex}
				
				if roundedTime not in alarmDict.keys():
					alarmDict[roundedTime] = {}
				if name not in alarmDict[roundedTime].keys():
					alarmDict[roundedTime][name] = {}
				if alarm not in alarmDict[roundedTime][name].keys():
					alarmDict[roundedTime][name][alarm] = {}
				if aisle not in alarmDict[roundedTime][name][alarm].keys():
					alarmDict[roundedTime][name][alarm][aisle] = {}
				if sensor not in alarmDict[roundedTime][name][alarm][aisle].keys():
					alarmDict[roundedTime][name][alarm][aisle][sensor] = [sensorInfo]
				else:
					alarmDict[roundedTime][name][alarm][aisle][sensor].append(sensorInfo)
			
			# generate dataset to write
			headers = ['Time', 'TagName' ,'AlarmName', 'Aisles', 'Sensors', 'SensorList', 'SensorMap']
			data = []
			maxSensorsPerAisle = max([int(i) for i in tagsDataset.getColumnAsList(tagsDataset.getColumnIndex('sensor'))])
			maxAislesPerZone = max([int(i) for i in tagsDataset.getColumnAsList(tagsDataset.getColumnIndex('aisle'))])
			for time in sorted(alarmDict.keys(), reverse=True):
				for tagName in alarmDict[time].keys():
					for al in alarmDict[time][tagName].keys():
						newRow = []
						sensorMap = [[None]*maxSensorsPerAisle for _ in xrange(maxAislesPerZone+1)]
						aisles = 0
						sensors = 0
						sensorList = []
						for a in alarmDict[time][tagName][al].keys():
							aisles += 1
							for s in alarmDict[time][tagName][al][a].keys():
								sensors += 1
								index = alarmDict[time][tagName][al][a][s][0]['index']
								aisleName = tagsDataset.getValueAt(index, 'aisleName')
								aisle = int(tagsDataset.getValueAt(index, 'aisle'))
								sensor = int(tagsDataset.getValueAt(index, 'sensor'))
								
								sensorList.append('%sS%s'%(aisleName,sensor))

								eventValues = [obj['eventValue'] for obj in alarmDict[time][tagName][al][a][s]]
								if 'above' in al.lower():
									value = max(eventValues)
								else:
									value = min(eventValues)
								sensorMap[aisle-1][sensor-1] = value
						sensorStr = ','.join(sensorList)
						newRow = [system.date.fromMillis(time), tagName, al, aisles, sensors, sensorStr, str(sensorMap)]
						data.append(newRow)
			ds = system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, data)
			
			# write to tags
			writePaths = [
				  "[.]Alarms"
				, "[.]AlarmsExecuteTime"
				, "[.]Status"
				, tagPath
			]
			values = [
				  ds
				, system.date.millisBetween(startTime, system.date.now())
				, 'Executed on %s' % (system.date.now())
				, False
			]

		except:
			writePaths = [
				  "[.]AlarmsExecuteTime"
			  	, "[.]Status"
				, tagPath]
			values = [
				  system.date.millisBetween(startTime, system.date.now())
				, "Error at %s on: %s" % (system.date.now(),traceback.format_exc())
				, False
			]
		finally:
			system.tag.writeAsync(writePaths, values)

if currentValue.value:
		import traceback
		scriptStart = system.date.now()
		try:
			# read in required values
			readPaths = [
				 "[.]../Parameters.MinutesBack"
				,"[.]../Tags/Tags"
			]
			tags = system.tag.readBlocking(readPaths)
			minutesBack = tags[0].value
			tagDataset = tags[1].value
			tagPaths = list(tagDataset.getColumnAsList(0))
			
			# setup time range
			end = system.date.fromMillis(system.date.toMillis(system.date.now())/1000*1000)
			start = system.date.addMinutes(end, -minutesBack)
			
			# get history
			dataset = system.tag.queryTagHistory(
				paths=tagPaths, 
				startDate=start, endDate=end,
				intervalSeconds = 1,
				aggregationMode="LastValue", 
				returnFormat='Wide')

			# write to tags
			writePaths = [
				  "[.]History"
				, "[.]HistoryExecuteTime"
				, "[.]Status"
				, tagPath
			]
			values = [
				  dataset
				, system.date.millisBetween(scriptStart, system.date.now())
				, 'Executed on %s' % (system.date.now())
				, False
			]
		except:
			writePaths = [
				  "[.]HistoryExecuteTime"
			  	, "[.]Status"
				, tagPath]
			values = [
				  system.date.millisBetween(scriptStart, system.date.now())
				, "Error at %s on: %s" % (system.date.now(),traceback.format_exc())
				, False
			]
		finally:
			system.tag.writeAsync(writePaths, values)

startTime = system.date.now()
	import re

	# read needed tags
	tags = system.tag.readBlocking([
		  "[.]../Parameters.PathToParentFolder"
	])
	pathToParentFolder = tags[0].value	
		
	# browse for aisle UDTs
	aisleUdts = system.tag.browse(pathToParentFolder, 
		{'name': 'Aisle*', 'tagType':'UdtInstance', 'recursive': True}).getResults()	
	
	# read Name and AisleType tags of the UDT
	namePaths = ['%s/Name' % aisle['fullPath'] for aisle in aisleUdts]
	typePaths = ['%s/AisleType' % aisle['fullPath'] for aisle in aisleUdts]
	nameTypeTags = system.tag.readBlocking(namePaths + typePaths)
	nameType = [(nameTypeTags[i].value, nameTypeTags[i+len(namePaths)].value) for i in xrange(len(namePaths))]
	
	# browse every UDT for atomic tags to compile a dataset of tags
	pattern = re.compile(r'/Aisle(\d+)/Sensor(\d+)/')
	data = []
	coldData = []
	hotData = []
	for aisleUdt, (aisleName, aisleType) in zip(aisleUdts, nameType):
		udts = system.tag.browse(str(aisleUdt['fullPath']), 
			{'tagType':'AtomicTag','recursive':True}
		).getResults()
		
		for udt in udts:
			fullPath = str(udt['fullPath'])
			match = pattern.search(fullPath)
			name = fullPath.split('/')[-1]
			isCold = aisleType == 'AisleCold'
				
			if match:
				aisle = int(match.group(1))
				sensor = match.group(2)
				alarmSourceStart = fullPath.replace('[','prov:').replace(']',':/tag:')
				alarmSourceWildcard = '%s*' % alarmSourceStart
				row = [fullPath, name, aisle, sensor, isCold, aisleName, alarmSourceStart, alarmSourceWildcard]
				data.append(row)
				if name == 'Temperature':
					if isCold:
						coldData.append(row)
					else:
						hotData.append(row)
				
	# convert to datasets
	headers = ['fullPath', 'name', 'aisle', 'sensor', 'isCold', 'aisleName', 'alarmSourceStart', 'alarmSourceWildcard']
	dataset = system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, data)
	coldDataset = system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, coldData)
	hotDataset = system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, hotData)
	
	# get configs of every atomic in UDT
	basePath = '_types_/Exchange/DataCenterDemo/Equipment/Heatmap/SensorCold'
	getConfigs = system.tag.getConfiguration(basePath, True)
	configs = {}	
	for config in getConfigs[0]['tags']:
		configs[config['name']] = {
			 'name': config['name']
			,'engLow': config.get('engLow')
			,'engHigh': config.get('engHigh')
			,'engUnit': config.get('engUnit')
		}

	# create expression for ActiveAlarmCount tag
	activeAlarmCountPath = "[.]../Alarms/ActiveAlarmCount"
	activeAlarmFolderPath = activeAlarmCountPath[:activeAlarmCountPath.rfind('/')]
	activeAlarmCount = system.tag.getConfiguration(activeAlarmCountPath, False)
	activeAlarmCount[0]['expression'] = ' + '.join(['{%s/Alarms.ActiveUnackCount}' % row[0] for row in data])
	system.tag.configure(activeAlarmFolderPath, activeAlarmCount[0], collisionPolicy = 'o')

	# write to tags
	system.tag.writeAsync(
		[
			"[.]Tags"
			,"[.]../Aggregate/ColdAisleTemperature/Config/DatasetInput"
			,"[.]../Aggregate/HotAisleTemperature/Config/DatasetInput"
			,"[.]Configs"
			,"[.]TagsGenerateTime"
			,tagPath
		], 
		[
			dataset
			,coldDataset
			,hotDataset
			,configs
			,system.date.millisBetween(startTime, system.date.now())
			,False
		]
	)

if currentValue.value:
		tags = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]Index", "[.]../TagList/ExecuteTags"])
		
		# only trigger one tag from the list per cycle
		executeTags = tags[1].value
		executeIndex = (tags[0].value+1) % executeTags.getRowCount()

		
		tagPaths = [
			executeTags.getValueAt(executeIndex,0)
			,"[.]Index"
			,"[.]IndexMax"
			,"[.]Tag"
			,"[.]Timestamp"
		]
		values = [
			 True
			,executeIndex
			,executeTags.getRowCount() - 1
			,executeTags.getValueAt(executeIndex,0)
			,system.date.now()
		]
		
		system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, values)

if currentValue.value:
		startTime = system.date.now()
		typeId = 'Exchange/DataCenterDemo/Equipment/Heatmap/Summary'
		pathToParentFolder = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../Parameters.PathToParentFolder"])[0].value
		
		udtPaths = system.tag.browse(pathToParentFolder, {'typeId': typeId, 'tagType':'UdtInstance', 'recursive': True})
		def makeName(p):
			fullPath = str(p['fullPath'])
			return "-".join(fullPath.split('/')[2:5])
		
		udtList = system.dataset.toDataSet(['path','name'], [[str(path['fullPath']),  makeName(path)] for path in udtPaths])
		
		executeList = []
		generateList = []
		for i in xrange(udtList.getRowCount()):
			et = system.tag.browse(udtList.getValueAt(i,0), {'name': '*Execute', 'tagType':'AtomicTag', 'recursive': True})
			for t in et:
				executeList.append([str(t['fullPath'])])
				
			gt = system.tag.browse(udtList.getValueAt(i,0), {'name': '*Generate', 'tagType':'AtomicTag', 'recursive': True})
			for t in gt:
				generateList.append([str(t['fullPath'])])
				
		executeTags = system.dataset.toDataSet(['path'], executeList)
		generateTags = system.dataset.toDataSet(['path'], generateList)
		
		tagPaths = [
			 "[.]Status"
 			,"[.]UdtList"
 			,"[.]ExecuteTags"
 			,"[.]GenerateTags"
			,tagPath
			,"[.]TagListBrowseTime"
		] + list(generateTags.getColumnAsList(0))
		
		values = [
			'Last Browsed @ %s ' % (system.date.now())
			,udtList
			,executeTags
			,generateTags
			,False
			,system.date.millisBetween(startTime, system.date.now())
		] + [True] * generateTags.getRowCount()
		
		system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, values)
